title: 5.5.4 Lab: Steer it
description: The block only walks right and walks off the edge. Add the four arrow keys with two direction variables, forbid turning back on yourself, and end the round at a wall.

steps.title: Turn with the arrow keys
steps.instructions: The block moves by `dx` and `dy` each step, but nothing changes them. In `draw()`, set `dx` and `dy` when an arrow key is pressed: up is `dx = 0; dy = -1`, and so on for down, left and right.
hints: `kb.presses('up')` is true on the frame the key goes down.
Four `if` lines, one per key. Each sets both `dx` and `dy` so the block never moves diagonally.

steps.title: No turning back
steps.instructions: Pressing the opposite key while moving would send the snake straight back into itself. Allow up and down only when `dy === 0`, and left and right only when `dx === 0`.
hints: Add `&& dy === 0` to the up and down tests, and `&& dx === 0` to left and right.
Run it and press left while moving right. Nothing should happen.

steps.title: Stop at the wall
steps.instructions: After the step, if the new column or row is off the grid (below 0, or 20 or more), set `playing` to `false`. Otherwise move the block on screen: the two pixel lines already in the starter go in the `else`, so a dead block stays on the last cell it reached. The starter already shows 'Game over' when `playing` is false, from `drawTop()` at the bottom, so the block can never cover the words.
hints: `if (...off the grid...) { playing = false; } else { head.x = ...; head.y = ...; }`

requirements.title: Each arrow key sets the direction
requirements.description: Pressing up, down, left or right changes dx and dy together. Help: 5.5.2 (Reading: A world on a grid)

requirements.title: A turn straight back is refused
requirements.description: Each of the four keys refuses a turn straight back: up and down only when the block is not already moving up or down (dy === 0), left and right only when dx === 0. Help: 5.5.2 (Reading: A world on a grid)

requirements.title: Leaving the grid ends the round
requirements.description: A column or row off the grid sets the flag false. Help: 5.4.8 (Lab: Crash, and start again)
